problem:
Problem description
- There is a finite set of products $$\mathcal{P}$$ indexed by $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$, a finite set of raw materials $$\mathcal{R}$$ indexed by $$r \in \mathcal{R}$$, and a planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}$$.
- Each product $$p$$ has a unit raw-material requirement, a unit labor requirement, and a unit profit before overtime pay.
- Each raw material $$r$$ has a limited available supply for the planning horizon.
- Regular labor is available up to a fixed capacity, and any labor use beyond that capacity must be covered by overtime.
- Overtime labor has an hourly payment rate and acts as a penalty cost in the planning decision.
- The planning goal is to choose production quantities and overtime usage so that total profit is maximized while overtime usage is kept as low as possible, subject to all resource limits.
- Required business constraints:
  - Production quantities must be nonnegative for every product.
  - Total consumption of each raw material must not exceed its available supply.
  - Total labor needed for production must be covered by regular labor and, if necessary, overtime labor.
  - Overtime is allowed only when regular labor is insufficient.
  - Overtime payment must be included when evaluating the plan’s profit.
  - The plan must remain feasible with respect to all material and labor capacities.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_p$$: the quantity of product $$p$$ to produce over the planning horizon.
  - $$o$$: the total overtime labor hours used over the planning horizon.
  - Optional summary values such as total pre-overtime profit, overtime cost, and net profit.

Input Format
{
  "P": "integer $$|\mathcal{P}|$$, number of products",
  "R": "integer $$|\mathcal{R}|$$, number of raw materials",
  "T": "integer $$|\mathcal{T}|$$, number of planning periods in the horizon",
  "product_names": "optional list of length $$P$$ identifying the products in $$\mathcal{P}$$",
  "material_names": "optional list of length $$R$$ identifying the raw materials in $$\mathcal{R}$$",
  "available_material": "vector $$s \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}^{R}$$, where $$s_r$$ is the available amount of raw material $$r$$",
  "material_usage": "matrix $$a \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}^{R \times P}$$, where $$a_{r,p}$$ is the amount of raw material $$r$$ needed per unit of product $$p$$",
  "labor_usage": "vector $$h \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}^{P}$$, where $$h_p$$ is the labor hours needed per unit of product $$p$$",
  "regular_labor_capacity": "scalar $$L \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$$, regular labor hours available over the planning horizon",
  "unit_profit": "vector $$\pi \in \mathbb{R}^{P}$$, where $$\pi_p$$ is the profit per unit of product $$p$$ before overtime pay",
  "overtime_wage": "scalar $$c^{\mathrm{ot}} \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$$, overtime payment per labor hour"
}

Output Format
{
  "production_plan": {
    "quantity": "vector $$x \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}^{P}$$, where $$x_p$$ is the production quantity of product $$p$$"
  },
  "overtime_plan": {
    "hours": "scalar $$o \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$$, total overtime labor hours used"
  },
  "objective_summary": {
    "gross_profit": "scalar, total profit before overtime payment",
    "overtime_cost": "scalar, total overtime payment",
    "net_profit": "scalar, total profit after overtime payment"
  }
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "P": 2,
  "R": 2,
  "T": 1,
  "product_names": ["A", "B"],
  "material_names": ["steel", "aluminum"],
  "available_material": [200, 300],
  "material_usage": [
    [6, 12],
    [8, 20]
  ],
  "labor_usage": [11, 24],
  "regular_labor_capacity": 300,
  "unit_profit": [5000, 11000],
  "overtime_wage": 100
}

parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning problem

parameters.name: num_raw_materials
parameters.description: Number of raw materials in the planning problem

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: material_names
parameters.description: Optional identifiers for the raw materials

parameters.name: available_material
parameters.description: Available amount of each raw material over the planning horizon

parameters.name: material_usage
parameters.description: Unit raw material requirement of each product for each raw material

parameters.name: labor_usage
parameters.description: Labor hours required per unit of each product

parameters.name: regular_labor_capacity
parameters.description: Regular labor capacity over the planning horizon

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit of each product before overtime payment

parameters.name: overtime_wage
parameters.description: Overtime payment rate per labor hour

variables.name: overtime_hours
variables.description: Total overtime labor hours used over the planning horizon

constraints.name: raw_material_capacity
constraints.description: For each raw material r, total consumption across all products cannot exceed available supply.

constraints.name: labor_capacity_with_overtime
constraints.description: Total labor required by production must be covered by regular labor capacity and overtime hours.

objectives.name: net_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total net profit over the planning horizon, defined as total pre-overtime profit minus overtime payment.

objectives.name: overtime_minimization_tiebreak
objectives.description: Prefer lower overtime usage among plans with the same net profit.

final_objective.description: Use preemption optimization to maximize total net profit first, then minimize overtime usage among solutions with the same net profit.
